feeds.title: Urban Cottage Life
feeds.description: My name is Marlene Cornelis. I'm a home cook, recipe developer and food writer living in London. I'm passionate about what I like to call modern scratch living: preparing good food from scratch, reviving the art of relaxed hospitality, and doing the odd crafting or home updating projects. I started the blog as a space to exercise my love of writing. Sometimes the focus is all on the food, but I also share personal and family stories and musings.

feeds.title: Ontario Culinary
feeds.description: Ontario Culinary is your field guide to best food & drink in our big, BIG province. Discover delicious destinations, explore Feast On Certified restaurants and purveyors, meet the people behind the products - then start planning your next edible adventure with the Great Taste of Ontario.

feeds.title: Not Far From the Tree
feeds.description: We're Toronto's fruit-picking and sharing project. We work to connect generous tree registrants with excess fruit to volunteers in their community who are willing to pick and share it. No good fruit should fall to waste when so many people can use it! Keep up to date with the latest news and resources, information on fruits in the country and more!

feeds.title: Closet Cooking
feeds.description: Kevin came to realize that my meals were boring and that he had been eating the same few dishes over and over again for years. It was time for a change! He now spends his free time searching for, creating and trying tasty new recipes in his closet-sized kitchen. Check out his easy-to-make, delicious recipes here.

feeds.title: The Girl on Bloor
feeds.description: Hi I'm Taylor. I'm a fun-loving, 20-something city girl who's been living in downtown Toronto on and off Bloor Street for over six years. My blog aims to help other super busy people like me eat more wholesome, homemade foods on-the-go, and a large part of that is meal prepping.

feeds.title: Hungry 416
feeds.description: Your favourite go-to Toronto foodie & blogger! Find the best places to eat, hang out and have fun in Toronto, GTA & Ontario, dig into all your favourite dishes with our easy-to-follow delicious recipes and discover exciting festivals, events, workshops, concerts, and celebrations.

feeds.title: Simply Stacie
feeds.description: Simply Stacie is a lifestyle blog by a Canadian mom which is full of delicious recipes, easy crafts, household tips, and other fun ideas to inspire readers to embrace an extraordinary life. Here you can discover recipes for weeknight meals, holiday meals, potlucks, and more!

feeds.title: Seasons And Suppers
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jennifer and I am cooking my way through the seasons in beautiful Muskoka, Ontario, Canada. Seasons and Suppers is my online food blog and cooking diary, where I get a chance to share what's cooking in my kitchen throughout the year.

feeds.title: Eat Live Travel Write
feeds.description: Eat Live Travel Write by Mardi Michels is a blog about culinary adventures, near and far. Recipes (with a focus on French food), travel stories, kids' cooking, cookbook reviews and more. She is a full-time French teacher at an elementary school for boys in Toronto and runs cooking classes for boys aged 7-12.

feeds.title: Toronto Food Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Ashley Allinson. Toronto Food Blog is my blog for the budget-conscious reader who wants to know what, where and when to eat in Toronto. Toronto Food Blog is for the budget-conscious reader, willing to venture off the beaten path to find the best cheap eats in the Six.

feeds.title: Taste Detours Blog
feeds.description: Explore local blogs, articles and musings about food, drinks, food people and Taste Detours. Taste Detours are food and drink tours with a heritage twist. On these flavourful tours we introduce you to our local, independent food people and places. In between these tasting stops we spotlight history, architecture, and culture - step bite step.

feeds.title: The Food Bank of Waterloo Region Blog
feeds.description: Read more about our food bank, sponsors' stories, easy and affordable recipes, news and more! The Food Bank of Waterloo Region is committed to providing emergency food assistance and support throughout the region, ensuring no one is left behind. Working in collaboration with 120+ community programs and agency partners, our goal is to reduce hunger in our region and identify proactive solutions to address poverty and food insecurity.

feeds.title: Food and Beverage Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Food and Beverage Ontario is the provincial professional leadership organization for food and beverage processors across Ontario. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates, vacancies, industry insights and more in Ontario food and beverage industry.

feeds.title: The Joyce of Cooking
feeds.description: The Joyce of Cooking is a content creator for all things food! From partnered content, to food photography, to food styling and social media content creation. Work with me to take your business to the next level!

feeds.title: Wild Foods Blog
feeds.description: Browse our blog to learn more about wild foods, sustainable harvesting methods, and to try some deliciously wild recipes. Discover real Canadian cuisine and eat something wild! Forbes Wild Foods is a Canadian company that proudly supplies wild, hand-picked foods to restaurants; farmers markets; hotels; gift, food, and health stores; and to individual customers via our online store. All of our foods are sustainably harvested from the Canadian wilderness by trained, knowledgeable pickers.

feeds.title: Seasonal Ontario Food
feeds.description: Like a lot of people, I am trying to eat more local seasonal food. I post recipes here, in their season, which consist of at least 80% Ontario grown or produced food. (There will be a few exceptions - some things are just too good to pass up!) My bias is towards organic, and a number of food sensitivities will give an odd kick to my gallop.

feeds.title: Living Lou
feeds.description: Covers articles about creating simple, fresh and flavorful recipes for the modern kitchen. Louisa is the writer, recipe developer and photographer behind the Canadian food blog Living Lou. She is passionate about leading a healthy lifestyle and creates simple, healthy and nutritious recipes to inspire others to follow suit.

feeds.title: Foodie2Luv
feeds.description: I started Foodie2Luv blog two years ago when I realized that I was too broke to eat out. My recipes are super simple and quick to make, and in case you haven't noticed - there's nothing fancy or 'restaurant quality' about my dishes. Besides putting up recipes, I also review restaurants.

feeds.title: Western Foodies Blog
feeds.description: ]Western Foodies is here to bring food lovers together in a social environment. We will cook, bake, learn, and of course, eat! Throughout the year, we host events such as restaurant visits, socials, volunteering events, eating competitions, cooking classes, and food giveaways. Stay up to date on our events, schedules, recipes and more!

feeds.title: Toronto Food Safety Training Blog
feeds.description: Toronto Food Safety Training blog is sharing The Spice Lady's recipes, stories, and tips. Toronto Food Safety Training is a registered provider of food handler certificates. Our passion is sharing vital information to keep you and your customers safe from hazards that lead to foodborne illness.

feeds.title: The Food District
feeds.description: Your source for the latest culinary news, mouthwatering recipes, and much more. The Food District is a combination of your local baker, seafood market, juicery and restaurants all rolled into one curated market. With more than 25 artisans, merchants and eateries offering dine-in experiences and to-go options, there is definitely something for everyone at The Food District.
